frozen_note: written and committed before the first D5.3 epoch was produced; the acceptance rule below was fixed before any D5.3 result existed

s3a550.lease: second lease, after the S1 conclusion is read

budget.note: one uniform budget for every arm; D5.2's 300-epoch runs stay historical evidence and are not pooled with D5.3

censoring_rule.budget_censored: the run reached the 400-epoch cap and its best epoch lies inside the final patience window
censoring_rule.reason: a run still improving at the cap has not shown converged capability; the equal-budget comparison remains valid
censoring_rule.extension_policy: any extension must cover all arms in one new uniform budget, never only the arm that looks weaker

acceptance_rule.primary_unit: seed (n = 3), each arm's own minimum-validation-loss checkpoint
stable: the paired difference chromatic - achromatic has the same sign in 3/3 seeds
at least 8 of 9 validation scenes agree in every seed
reported_regardless: plateau epoch-to-epoch standard deviation as a training-stability diagnostic
not_allowed: treating three seeds times nine scenes as 27 independent experiments
using plateau variation as a substitute for seed variance
comparing validation loss across arms (each arm normalises by its own forward RMS; measured difference 0.04%)

data.test_policy: test.npz is never downloaded, uploaded or loaded in D5.3
